abilities.name: United Front
abilities.description: When an allied Digimon is within 3 spaces of your partner Digimon, you may spend Hope equal to your Reliability rank to add your Reliability rank to your partner Digimon's damage roll.

abilities.name: Extended Bond
abilities.description: United Front's range increases from 3 spaces to 6 spaces.

abilities.name: Steady Reserve
abilities.description: United Front now costs a flat 2 Hope per use instead of Hope equal to your Reliability rank.

abilities.name: Precise Form
abilities.description: Once per encounter, your partner Digimon may reroll one attack roll and take the higher result.

abilities.name: Rally Point
abilities.description: When you use United Front, every allied Digimon within range gains the same damage bonus on their next attack, not just your partner.

abilities.name: The Right Move
abilities.description: Once per session, after your partner Digimon's attack roll connects, you may deal maximum damage instead of rolling. This is used after the hit roll, once you already know the result. If the attack roll was a critical hit, the maximum damage includes crit damage. If it wasn't a critical hit, it doesn't.
